topic: Phone ki kashish — the gravity of the phone

targets.holds: exactly one uncut set-piece ≥ 3 s containing the impossible moment; no other shot > 4 s
targets.transition_kinds_note: wtf30: cut grammar + the impossible transition itself; never a cut inside the WTF window
targets.new_on_screen_every_s: ≤ 2.5 (a physical event: light, prop, scale, readout, line — measured as beats)
targets.gates: 19 measured gates + gate #20 freshness + the 13 WTF gates (doctrine §11)
targets.loop_seam: last frame rejoins frame 1 (≤ 6/255 mean abs difference or a designed match-cut)
targets.law_broken: exactly one of gravity, scale, time, light, mirror, material, continuity, count, space, causality

hook_text: phone face-DOWN buzzing; a pencil rolls uphill toward it by itself; the phone flips itself face-UP and amber floods the desk
impossible_moment: The phone on the desk becomes the room's planet: every prop slides radially toward it and piles in a ring; the hero hangs horizontal from the door jamb like a flag, lets go, flies to the desk and flips the phone face-down — gravity snaps back and everything drops flat.
loop_seam: S6/S7 are S1 evaluated at loop time (tau = t-20): the world whip-rolls 180° at 19.12, holds upside-down, the buzz at 19.70 (= loop -0.30) snaps it upright and wipes the words; pencil begins rolling at 19.6; frame 600 == frame 1 by construction (mean abs diff measured by gate.py)
title: THE GRAVITY OF THE PHONE
shot_list: S1 desk medium: phone face-down buzzing, pencil rolls toward it, phone flips itself face-up, glow floods (CRACK 1)
S2 wide room: hero enters from the door with a book; clock pendulum + pages lean toward the desk (CRACK 2)
S3 ECU hero bust: notices the lean
S4 THE SHOT, uncut 10.0 s: radial pull, jamb grip, horizontal flag, book sucked away, look-at-lens, let go, flight, flip face-down, glow dies, silence, drop flat
S5 meaning shot: closer on hero + dead phone; line snaps 15.4

S6 desk (loop time): 'Warna' · 'tum' · 'ulte.' (upside-down) — then the WHOLE WORLD whip-rolls 180° (19.12–19.38, punch-zoom, 12-sample motion blur) and holds upside-down: only 'ulte.' reads upright; 'uh-oh' vocal chop
S7 snap-back: the buzz cuts the world upright and wipes the words; pencil already rolling — frame 600 flows into frame 1

comment_engine.principle: every plant is visible on a normal watch or a pause — no subliminal frames, no hidden tricks; each is physically motivated by the film's one broken law

plants.what: the phone is an iPhone and its lock screen reads 9:41 (Apple's keynote time); the wall clock reads 9:41 too
while the field is on, the wall clock's hands spin through 5 hours (9:41 → 2:41) and the lock screen races with them; both stop dead at the drop
a framed photo: Monarch-in-the-photo is pulled across the glass and plastered to the edge nearest the phone; the friend turns to watch; after the drop he slides down the glass
plants.hook: background character + debate ('why only one of them?')

plants.what: on 'tum' the friend in the photo points straight at the lens, then the world rolls
a moth circles the lamp, leaves it for the brighter screen, orbits the phone like a satellite while the field is on (tighter and faster), tumbles when the field dies and staggers back to the lamp
plants.hook: 'we are the moth' metaphor + tiny-moving-thing eye magnet

plants.what: the coffee steam bends AWAY from the phone while everything else falls toward it (hot air is buoyant: it moves opposite to gravity)
plants.hook: physics debate with a defensible answer

plants.what: the lock-screen wallpaper is a slowly turning amber spiral; in the ECU its bands sweep his face
plants.hook: hypnotic motion on the brightest object
